CISA CPGs 2.0 (with PCI DSS v4.0.1 for payment environments)
CISA Cross-Sector CPGs 2.0; PCI DSS v4.0.1

No mandatory sector-specific cyber regulation exists for commercial facilities (lodging, gaming, venues, retail, real estate); the CISA CPGs are the SRMA's own baseline and cover IT/OT (building systems) broadly, while PCI DSS is the only mandatory-by-contract standard for card-heavy venues. State gaming regulators may impose additional rules (not researched).
